description.zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
description.en: The application ID of the user, generated when the application is created in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.

description.zh: 课程唯一标识，由调用CreateClass返回。
description.en: The unique identifier of the class, returned by calling CreateClass.

description.zh: 操作人用户ID，仅支持英文字母和数字，长度最多36个字符。
description.en: The user ID of the operator. The value can contain only letters and digits and is up to 36 characters in length.
